mapper.select: SELECT user_id as "userId", login_id as "loginId", password_hash as "passwordHash", user_name as "userName", system_use_yn as "systemUseYn" FROM user_account WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT user_id as "userId", login_id as "loginId", user_name as "userName", system_use_yn as "systemUseYn" FROM user_account WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT role_code FROM user_role_assignment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY role_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_store(session_id, user_id, expires_at) VALUES(#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT s.session_id as "sessionId", s.user_id as "userId", u.login_id as "loginId", u.user_name as "userName", s.expires_at as "expiresAt" FROM session_store s JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.session_id = #{sessionId} AND s.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND u.system_use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT status_key as "statusKey", status_value as "statusValue", description, checked_at as "checkedAt" FROM delivery_status ORDER BY status_key

SELECT org_code as "orgCode", org_name as "orgName", org_type as "orgType", parent_org_code as "parentOrgCode", start_date as "startDate", end_date as "endDate", status, changed_at as "changedAt" FROM organization (org_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter}, '%') OR org_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter}, '%') OR org_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter}, '%')) ORDER BY parent_org_code NULLS FIRST, org_code LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT ura.assignment_id as "assignmentId", u.user_id as "userId", u.employee_no as "employeeNo", u.user_name as "userName", r.role_code as "roleCode", r.role_name as "roleName", ura.valid_from as "validFrom", ura.valid_to as "validTo", ura.approver_id as "approverId", ura.assignment_source as "assignmentSource", ura.status FROM user_role_assignment ura JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id=ura.user_id JOIN role r ON r.role_code=ura.role_code (u.employee_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter}, '%') OR u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter}, '%') OR r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter}, '%') OR r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter}, '%')) ORDER BY u.employee_no, r.role_code LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT menu_id as "menuId", parent_menu_id as "parentMenuId", menu_name as "menuName", screen_id as "screenId", route_path as "routePath", icon_name as "iconName", business_area as "businessArea", description, sort_order as "sortOrder", use_yn as "useYn", status FROM menu ORDER BY parent_menu_id NULLS FIRST, sort_order, menu_id

SELECT group_id as "groupId", code_value as "codeValue", code_name as "codeName", parent_code_value as "parentCodeValue", sort_order as "sortOrder", use_yn as "useYn", valid_from as "validFrom", valid_to as "validTo", extra_attributes as "extraAttributes" FROM detail_code WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY sort_order, code_value

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id as "menuId", m.parent_menu_id as "parentMenuId", m.menu_name as "menuName", m.screen_id as "screenId", m.route_path as "routePath", m.icon_name as "iconName", m.sort_order as "sortOrder" FROM menu m JOIN menu_permission mp ON mp.menu_id=m.menu_id WHERE m.use_yn='Y' AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND mp.target_type='ROLE' AND mp.can_access='Y' AND mp.target_id IN #{role} ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.menu_id
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET system_use_yn=#{systemUseYn}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE user_role_assignment SET status='REVOKED', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_role_assignment(user_id, role_code, valid_from, valid_to, approver_id, assignment_source, status) VALUES(#{userId}, #{roleCode}, CURRENT_DATE, NULL, #{actorId}, 'MANUAL', 'ACTIVE')

INSERT INTO change_history(entity_name, entity_id, action_type, before_value, after_value, reason, actor_id) VALUES(#{entityName}, #{entityId}, #{actionType}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{reason}, #{actorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE role SET role_name=#{roleName}, purpose=#{purpose}, grant_criteria=#{grantCriteria}, default_data_scope=#{defaultDataScope}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE role_code=#{roleCode}

UPDATE menu SET parent_menu_id=#{parentMenuId}, menu_name=#{menuName}, screen_id=#{screenId}, route_path=#{routePath}, icon_name=#{iconName}, business_area=#{businessArea}, description=#{description}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, use_yn=#{useYn}, status=CASE WHEN #{useYn}='Y' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu(menu_id,parent_menu_id,menu_name,screen_id,route_path,icon_name,business_area,description,sort_order,use_yn,status) VALUES(#{menuId},#{parentMenuId},#{menuName},#{screenId},#{routePath},#{iconName},#{businessArea},#{description},#{sortOrder},#{useYn},CASE WHEN #{useYn}='Y' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END)
mapper.update: UPDATE code_group SET group_name=#{groupName}, description=#{description}, managing_department=#{managingDepartment}, use_yn=#{useYn}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE group_id=#{groupId}

UPDATE detail_code SET code_name=#{codeName}, parent_code_value=#{parentCodeValue}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, use_yn=#{useYn}, valid_from=CAST(#{validFrom} AS date), valid_to=CAST(#{validTo} AS date), extra_attributes=#{extraAttributes}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND code_value=#{codeValue}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO detail_code(group_id,code_value,code_name,parent_code_value,sort_order,use_yn,valid_from,valid_to,extra_attributes) VALUES(#{groupId},#{codeValue},#{codeName},#{parentCodeValue},#{sortOrder},#{useYn},CAST(#{validFrom} AS date),CAST(#{validTo} AS date),#{extraAttributes})
mapper.update: UPDATE organization SET parent_org_code=#{parentOrgCode}, start_date=CAST(#{startDate} AS date), end_date=CAST(#{endDate} AS date), changed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE org_code=#{orgCode}

UPDATE menu_permission SET can_read=#{canRead}, can_create=#{canCreate}, can_update=#{canUpdate}, can_disable=#{canDisable}, can_access=#{canAccess}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE target_type=#{targetType} AND target_id=#{targetId} AND menu_id=#{menuId}
UPDATE menu SET parent_menu_id=#{parentMenuId}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}
UPDATE menu SET sort_order=#{sortOrder}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}

UPDATE user_role_assignment SET valid_from=CAST(#{validFrom} AS date), valid_to=CAST(#{validTo} AS date), approver_id=#{approverId}, assignment_source=#{assignmentSource}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId}
UPDATE user_role_assignment SET status='REVOKED', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId}
